notes: The embedded version string reports commit 'unknown' because a git-archive extraction carries no .git; build.rs documents that as the honest value for exported trees. The authoritative source commit is git_commit_sha above.

By default sha256 is NOT reproducible across rebuilds: build.rs embeds wall-clock BEAD_BUILD_TIMESTAMP. It becomes reproducible when the build sets SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (embedded timestamp) and BEAD_COMMIT_SHA (commit) and the archived commit's build.rs supports them; verify by hash comparison against these pinned bytes, not by rebuilding.
